verdicts.evidence: Differs only where r.evidence is already empty, and then it swaps the em-dash placeholder for an empty table cell - both say "nothing recorded". Reachable but inert: probed on a mission whose floor.md carries `| security-prompt-injection | applied | |` (readManifest keeps a 3-column row with an empty evidence cell, conformance.ts:163), the EU draft goes from `| \`security-prompt-injection\` | applied | - | Floor |` to `| ... | applied |  | Floor |`. Surface: the Evidence column of the control-implementation table in the EU AI Act and NIST drafts. No value and no claim is lost, no test reads it, and no machine contract does either - the OSCAL derivation reads a row's `status`, never its `evidence`. Shared note on the three table helpers and who reads them: see survivor 17.
